summary: East kerb beside a grassy park, houses only across the road.
reasons: Nearest dwelling over 20 m, across road

best_section.where: Baty Street east kerb, beside the park lawn north of the first house

drivers.seclusion: East side is open park lawn and trees; homes sit on the west side, 20 m or more away.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with kerb; a van is parked at about 50 m in the QLD image, so there is room.
drivers.traffic: Quiet dead-end style residential street; busier road at the north end.
drivers.convention: Signs are 2P resident-excepted Mon-Fri 7am-6pm only, so overnight is outside them.

flags: Dwelling 7 m away at the 0 m start, avoid that end
Street is narrow, so check clearance
sun_shade: Tree canopy on the east side near the start and north end; the middle is open to the east and midday sun.
